flatten_tensor: flatten a torch tensor from [B, N, D1, ...] to [B*N, D1, ...] using batch_size and num_rounds
unflatten_tensor: unflatten a torch tensor from [B*N, D1, ...] back to [B, N, D1, ...] using batch_size and num_rounds
gather_states: gather states from relevant indices across multiple state tensors into a single concatenated tensor
test_flatten: test the flatten function with a tensor of shape [2, 3, 4, 5] and batch_size=2, num_rounds=3
test_unflatten: test the unflatten function with a tensor of shape [6, 4, 5] and batch_size=2, num_rounds=3
